name: Agent Prompt Pattern
description: Agentic rules for tool calling, code changes, and searching/reading in Cursor.

context.when_to_use: When using agentic rules for tool calling and code changes in Cursor.

steps: Follow tool call schema and provide all parameters
Never refer to tool names in user messages
Group edits to the same file in a single call
Fix linter errors if clear how to fix
Prefer semantic search for codebase queries
